name: LBS
description: Load Balancing System for task planning, scheduling, and workload adjustment.

config_fields.label: API Key
config_fields.description: API key issued by your LBS service.

setup_instructions.title: Prepare your LBS endpoint
setup_instructions.content: Confirm the LBS API is reachable from VisionArk (default: http://host.docker.internal:8001/api/lbs).

setup_instructions.title: Enter your API key
setup_instructions.content: Paste the LBS API key. It will be stored encrypted.

setup_instructions.title: Connect and verify
setup_instructions.content: Click Connect, then run a health check or ask an agent to list tasks.
